headline: Apple goes all-in on the smart home, Character.AI files for bankruptcy with Disney circling, Dragon is on its way to the ISS, and Verstappen swaps his F1 car for a Mercedes GT3 at Portimão this Saturday.

upcoming.what: CRS-35 Dragon docks at the ISS around 16:00 Irish time; Castlevania: Belmont's Curse launches
GTWC Europe finale, 3 Hours of Portimão, 17:00–20:00 Irish time, with Max Verstappen making his series debut
UFC Edmonton: Buckley vs Malott. Main card 01:00 Irish time (Sunday morning), prelims 22:00
WEC 6 Hours of Barcelona, 11:00 Irish time
ID@Xbox indie showcase, broadcast by IGN
F1 United States GP, Austin; MW4 releases on the 23rd; UFC 333 Volkanovski vs Evloev on the 24th (Irish clocks go back on the 25th)

items.headline: Apple's 'Welcome home' event: HomeView hub, new Apple TV and HomePod mini 2
items.summary: The $299 HomeView is a 7-inch touchscreen hub for the counter or wall, and the A19 Apple TV 4K also climbs to $299. Both ship 13 November; the $149 HomePod mini 2 lands 30 October. No Macs or iPads this time.

items.headline: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, Disney bids $20m for its assets
items.summary: The chatbot startup has gone into Chapter 11 and agreed to sell assets to Disney, whose opening bid is $20m. A wider sale is expected to wrap up by around December.

items.headline: Patch now: max-severity GitLab flaw allows unauthenticated code execution
items.summary: CVE-2026-97229 sits in the CI/CD regex compiler; fixes are in 19.2.8, 19.3.4 and 19.4.2. GitLab hasn't seen widespread exploitation yet. Separately, grocery giant Ahold Delhaize took systems offline after a cyberattack.

items.headline: Asian chip stocks slide; the IMF warns on AI valuations
items.summary: Korea's Kospi fell about 6%, with SK Hynix down 10%, after reports of a Chinese DRAM advance and cooler AI comments from Broadcom's CEO. The IMF says a sharp AI-stock correction could rattle global finance.

items.headline: CRS-35 is up: Dragon heads to the ISS with its final new solar arrays
items.summary: Falcon 9 lifted off from Cape Canaveral at 11:35 Irish time yesterday, and its twilight exhaust plume put on a 'space jellyfish' show along the US East Coast. Docking is due Thursday at about 16:00 Irish time.

items.headline: A Jurassic swimmer shows an early step towards suckling milk
items.summary: In a Nature paper, researchers describe Megacauda sungei, a 165-million-year-old aquatic mammal relative about 50cm long. Its soft palate let it breathe while swallowing, a key step on the road to nursing.

sections.title: Gaming
sections.summary: Nothing new on the watchlist (Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3, Borderlands).

items.headline: Report: GTA VI on PC in Q1 2027
items.summary: GamesBeat's sources say the PC version follows the 19 November console launch within a few months, a much shorter wait than GTA V had. Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.

items.headline: No Man's Sky is coming to iPhone and iPad
items.summary: Hello Games says the iOS port will carry almost everything from the PC and console versions.

items.headline: Epic reportedly bans hand-written code on its Star Wars/Marvel shooter
items.summary: Bloomberg says the delayed, unannounced project now requires generative AI tools for code and art. Also new: an ID@Xbox showcase on 20 October.

sections.title: BJJ & Grappling
sections.summary: A quiet week: only regional opens (ADCC New Jersey and Callao, F2W 328) before the weekend. Here's last week's UFC BJJ card in case you missed it.

items.headline: Catch-up: Cassia Moura becomes UFC BJJ's first double champ, on a disputed card
items.summary: At UFC BJJ 12 on 8 October, Moura took a split decision over Adele Fornarino, who had dominated the first round with leg locks. Renato Canuto won the lightweight belt, and Gilbert Burns was submitted early by Gabriel Almeida.

sections.title: MMA
sections.summary: Fight week in Edmonton; little else breaking.

items.headline: UFC Edmonton: Malott a slight favourite at home against Buckley
items.summary: Malott opens around -140 against Buckley at +120. Blanchfield vs Jasudavicius is the co-main, and Barriault and Landwehr are also on a Canada-heavy main card. That card starts at 01:00 Irish time on Sunday.

items.headline: McGregor's 'mega announcement'... is a TikTok account
items.summary: Conor teased something big and it turned out to be his TikTok debut, goat in hand. There's still no fight news.

items.headline: Verstappen makes his GT World Challenge debut at Portimão on Saturday
items.summary: He'll share the #3 Mercedes-AMG GT3 of his own Team Verstappen Racing with Ben Barnicoat and Chris Lulham in the 3-hour finale, 17:00–20:00 Irish time. Engel, Auer and Stolz have already wrapped up the Endurance Cup.

items.headline: What Antonelli needs to win the title in Austin
items.summary: He leads Russell by 102 points. To clinch at COTA he has to win, with Russell 9th or lower and Hamilton 5th or lower. Russell's engine penalty now looks set for later in the season, so Mexico or Brazil is the likelier decider.

items.headline: Russell: Red Bull are now 'the team to beat'
items.summary: After Verstappen's back-to-back wins in Malaysia and Singapore, Russell says Mercedes' upgrades are delivering the expected numbers but not the lap times.
